svg.aria-label: Which services run on which GPU. prxbox1 has a Quadro RTX 4000 with 8GB and runs Frigate for 4 cameras, Whisper for voice and a Tdarr worker. prxbox2 has an RTX A4000 with 16GB and runs Ollama and llama.cpp, Plex, Immich video and the Tdarr server plus a worker. Both connect to the 10G switch and the NAS.
